title: Earnings live updates: Nvidia and Walmart, 2 important bellwethers for the US economy, report results this week
title_zh: 盈利实时更新：美国经济两大重要领头羊英伟达和沃尔玛本周公布业绩
summary: Investors will get highly anticipated quarterly results from Nvidia (NVDA) on Wednesday in what’s expected to be the marquee earnings event of the week.
summary_zh: 投资者将于周三获得英伟达 (NVDA) 备受期待的季度业绩，预计这将是本周最重要的财报活动。

title: Wall Street futures slip as higher yields, oil prices weigh
title_zh: 由于收益率上升和油价承压，华尔街期货下跌
summary: By Ragini Mathur and Utkarsh Hathi May 18 (Reuters) - U.S. stock index futures edged lower on Monday as rising Treasury yields and oil prices weighed, while investors awaited key earnings from Nvidia
summary_zh: 路透拉吉尼·马图尔 (Ragini Mathur) 和乌特卡什·哈蒂 (Utkarsh Hathi) 5 月 18 日报道 - 由于美国国债收益率上升和油价上涨打压，美国股指期货周一小幅走低，投资者等待英伟达的重要财报

title: Indian court tells Apple to 'cooperate' in antitrust case
title_zh: 印度法院要求苹果公司在反垄断案件中“合作”
summary: NEW DELHI, May 18 (Reuters) - An Indian court has told Apple to "fully cooperate" with investigators in an antitrust case related to the iPhone ​apps market, not agreeing with the U.S. company's
summary_zh: 路透新德里 5 月 18 日 - 印度一家法院要求苹果公司在与 iPhone 应用市场相关的反垄断案件中“全力配合”调查人员，但不同意这家美国公司的说法

title: China’s Xpeng begins mass production of robotaxis in Guangzhou
title_zh: 中国小鹏汽车在广州开始量产机器人出租车
summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Xpeng said ‌on Monday it had ‌begun mass production of its first ​robotaxi at its Guangzhou headquarters, targeting fully driverless operations by early 2027.
summary_zh: 中国电动汽车制造商小鹏汽车周一表示，已开始在广州总部大规模生产首款自动驾驶出租车，目标是到 2027 年初实现完全无人驾驶。

title: Elon Musk Says He Wants to Get SpaceX IPO Underway ‘Pretty Soon’
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示他希望“很快”启动 SpaceX IPO
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Elon Musk said he’s back in Texas working on plans for an initial public offering of SpaceX as the rocket and artificial intelligence company gears up for the largest listing of all time.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——埃隆·马斯克表示，他已回到德克萨斯州，制定 SpaceX 的首次公开募股计划，这家火箭和人工智能公司正在为有史以来最大规模的上市做准备。

title: Commonwealth Bank of Australia names Mary-Anne Williams as chief AI scientist
title_zh: 澳大利亚联邦银行任命玛丽-安妮·威廉姆斯为首席人工智能科学家
summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia on Monday appointed Mary-Anne Williams as ‌its chief AI scientist in what the ‌bank said would be the first such role at ​an Australian lender.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚联邦银行周一任命玛丽-安妮·威廉姆斯为其首席人工智能科学家，该银行表示，这将是澳大利亚银行首次担任此类职位。

title: Anthropic's shadow IPO market is already flashing trillion-dollar prices
title_zh: Anthropic 的影子 IPO 市场已经闪出了数万亿美元的价格
summary: Anthropic is still private, but the market around it is starting to look very public.
summary_zh: Anthropic 仍然是私有的，但它周围的市场开始变得非常公开。

title: Investors eye Nvidia, bond yields, and the next commodity supercycle: What to watch this week
title_zh: 投资者关注英伟达、债券收益率和下一个大宗商品超级周期：本周看点
summary: Investors step into the week after a Friday in the red, spurred by a stable of geopolitical uncertainties post Trump-Xi summit, rising bond yields, and sticky inflation.
summary_zh: 受特习峰会后地缘政治不确定性稳定、债券收益率上升和通胀粘性的刺激，投资者在周五出现亏损后进入本周。
